visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and a tan t-shirt stands in a warmly lit indoor studio. Lush green plants are visible in the background. He holds a book titled '擁有了就好' and looks directly at the camera with a calm, friendly expression. (2) Close-up shots of multiple book spines on a shelf reveal the title and author name, '黃山料'. The lighting is dim and focused on the books. (3) A wide shot shows the silhouette of a couple walking along a beach during a vibrant sunset. The sky transitions from orange to purple, reflecting on the wet sand. (4) Back in the studio, the man gestures with the book, pointing at the cover and flipping through the pages. He maintains eye contact and a gentle smile. (5) A macro close-up features a crumpled piece of paper with handwritten Chinese text lying on a dark wooden surface under warm light. (6) A sequence of shots shows a hand lighting a candle with a lighter in a dark room, followed by close-ups of old photos and letters in a cardboard box. (7) Silhouettes of the couple appear again on the beach at dusk, dancing and embracing against the fading light. (8) The final scene shows several copies of the book stacked on a wooden table, with the publisher's logo visible in the corner.

(5) [Subtitle]: 但是 有些相遇只是為了錯過 為了讓我們成長而已. (6) [Subtitle]: 這本真實故事改編的小說是一本五萬字的情書. (7) [Subtitle]: 是告白 也是告別. (8) [Subtitle]: 是我以過客之名寫給你的最後一封情書. (9) [Subtitle]: 相遇的意義就是回想起來每當我快要被熄滅是你陪在我身邊支撐我走得更遠. (10) [Subtitle]: 一定會有一個人他理解你的過去參與了你的現在並讓你嚮往與他共同的未來. (11) [Subtitle]: 但是十年的羈絆為什麼沒有結果? (12) [Subtitle]: 這本書是這樣開始的. (13) [Subtitle]: 我和他是多年的好朋友. (14) [Subtitle]: 他來我家幫忙大掃除. (15) [Subtitle]: 偶然翻出一個搬家用的大箱子. (16) [Subtitle]: 這個箱子裡面裝了十年來關於我們的種種回憶. (17) [Subtitle]: 隨著這個箱子充滿回憶的物品被挖出來我們的記憶回到十年前. (18) [Subtitle]: 也趁這個機會終於把話說開. (19) [Subtitle]: 我們是如何一步步錯過彼此?現在是否還能挽回一切? (20) [Subtitle]: 書裡是這樣寫. (21) [Subtitle]: 生命短暫 離別猝不及防 想見的人去見 有誤會就說開 捨不得就別放手 爭吵了就合好 還愛就把握當下 痛苦就離開 不留遺憾 有緣時好好珍惜 緣盡了好好再見. (22) [Subtitle]: 這本書寫給那些來過卻終究離開的人. (23) [Subtitle]: 我以過客之名祝你們歲歲平安. (24) [Slogan]: 《擁有了就好》新書已經上架誠品書店 我們沒有封膜 歡迎到書店免費試閱.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional trailer for the author's new book, '擁有了就好'. It uses emotional storytelling, nostalgic silhouettes, and warm studio visuals to connect with readers' feelings of love and moving on, eventually inviting them to read the book in stores.
